  "type": "equity_research",
  "priority": "medium",
  "published": "2026-11-19",
  "insights": [
   "Barclays views recent Robotaxi and Cybercab updates as supportive of the Robotaxi narrative, citing the 24/7 operations expansion as a proof point for Tesla's camera-only AV software progress.",
   "Tesla has expanded its Robotaxi footprint to 8 US cities, with significant geofence expansions in Houston, Austin, and Miami.",
   "Cybercab production is ramping, with potential capacity of 300-400k+ units annually at Gigafactory Texas, though current Robotaxi service demand remains well below this level.",
   "Tesla announced a $3.3bn investment in Gigafactory Berlin to produce up to 1mn Cybercabs annually, but Barclays questions the European demand given the lack of Robotaxi presence and FSD approval in the EU.",
   "Customer-owned Cybercab sales are limited to an invite-only basis in Texas at ~$30k, with a $299/month subscription fee, which Barclays views as a marketing product with limited TAM for now.",
   "Barclays highlights the potential for 'Unsupervised' FSD on consumer vehicles as a significant future demand driver, with expectations for initial integration into the Robotaxi fleet in 2Q27."
  ],

    "action": "reiterate",
    "rating": "Overweight",
